title: Fire Technical Council Council Order No. 0015423: annual fire alarm verification and visual signal devices in sound-insulated music rooms at a recreation facility
jurisdiction: Alberta (order issued by an accredited municipality; the municipality is not named in the decision text)
code_edition: Alberta Fire Code 2006 and Alberta Building Code 1997 (stated on p.2 and p.6)
document_date: 2012-07-24 (dated; Chair signature block; hearing 2012-06-21; order dated 2012-03-14)

facts.text: The accredited municipality issued an order dated 14 March 2012 against a recreation association. The hearing was on 21 June 2012.
The order required an annual fire alarm maintenance inspection report to the fire safety codes officer, showing the system is maintained to CAN/ULC-S536 and is deficiency free.

The quoted order also set sub-requirements (a)-(c): documentation that a notifier fire alarm sub-panel in the deluge system of a theatre stage area is installed and verified to ABC 1997 and CAN/ULC-S537-97; documentation of the deluge flow monitoring device; and visual signal devices in any floor area within sound-insulating enclosures, including partly insulated ones.
The Council ordered that the Order is VARIED.

The panel varied item 2 to include the verification report for the fire alarm system, and varied item 3 on the original verification certificate, which should establish compatibility of the notifier with the MXL system.
The panel determined that the music rooms were designed for music practice and are sound insulated, and recorded that there is no line of sight to a visual fire alarm indication device.
The applicable codes are the Alberta Fire Code 2006 (AFC 2006) and the Alberta Building Code 1997 (ABC 97).
The decision is dated 24 July 2012 and carries a Chair signature block for the Fire Technical Council Appeal Panel.

limitations: Fire Code (AFC 2006) and building code (ABC 1997) editions are both dated relative to the current NBC(AE) 2023 and Alberta Fire Code; use for structure and documentation questions only.
The municipality is not named in the decision text. The room layout and device list are not in the file.

The quoted order mixes the theatre-stage deluge requirements and the music-room visual-device requirement under sub-items (a)-(c). The panel's varied items 2 and 3 are summarised from paras 21-22; the music-room disposition is in pp.8-9 and is summarised, not quoted in full.
